data.narrative:
Mazama is a Series A-stage company in the Climate & Energy sector founded by Sriram Vasantharajan, having raised $30M+ to date. The relevant peer universe comprises 9 same-sector companies: 1 public entity (LNZA) and 8 private firms including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen.

The Stage-Progression method is applicable here. Using the $30M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $60M. The Peer-Median method was not applied due to insufficient comparables meeting narrow filters—while 9 same-sector peers exist, none of the applicable subsets (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier) contained the minimum 3 datapoints required for reliable median calculation.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $51M to $69M, with a median point of $60M, derived from the single applicable methodology. The primary uncertainty is the reliance on a single valuation method; a robust analysis would require either additional same-stage Climate & Energy comparables with disclosed valuations or forward-looking revenue multiples if financial data become available. The $30M total-raised baseline should also be validated against actual post-money Series A terms to ensure it reflects true equity value rather than inflated figures.
